resumeProtocol.rule: If package.status is not CLOSED_PASS, continue exactly from firstIncompleteStep. Do not reconstruct the roadmap, do not request runtime authorization, do not materialize a new request ordinal, and do not treat any older checkpoint, PR body, live-state projection or lifecycle nextAction as authority over this package and its canonical ledger binding.

iterationBudget.rule: A macro-iteration counts only when it leaves a verifiable commit, PASS/FAIL evidence, package transition, gate consumption, or milestone closure. Diagnostics-only responses do not count as progress.
